**Totals**: 418 certificates over 209 tasks (window + gamma per task); fixture produce 65.3 ms + check 170.6 ms; chain sidecars 209 produced in 16.9 ms, checked in 149.7 ms; whole sweep 403.5 ms wall.

Benchmark semantics anchor: the upstream EBMC-generated SMV models carry NO INIT constraint, so every task is a from-every-state claim over demonic inputs — the universal form these certificates prove. Their published completions on this class (their own plot_cmp.py arrays, recomputed this leg, timeout 18000 s): our-'25-MILP 172/209, nuXmv-BDD 154/209, ABC 96/209, rIC3 129/209, NMC'24 0/209; virtual best-of-five 204/209 (blink-SL 21-25 fall to nothing published). House: 209/209 certified, with checkable artifacts.

Measurement rider: walls measured on a GB10 (aarch64), CPython 3.12, single thread, time.perf_counter. Certificates certify the pinned benchmark tree's .sv files (`neuralmc-pin/`, upstream `f2bd71c`). Trust ledger: consuming lemmas `StreettDemonic.lean` (recurrence halves) + `SafetyDemonic.lean` (window halves); the six until-introduction chain rules machine-checked as twins in BOTH provers — Lean (`TemporalRewrite.lean`; build exit 0) and HOL4 (`ltl_rewriteScript.sml`; build GREEN); standalone checkers `ck_safety.py` (ledger K0–K5) + `ck_manifest.py` (C0–C6) + `ck_specchain.py` (S0–S5, including the vga declared-repair record); trust-seam narrowing `groundtruth_sl.py` (independent re-transcription + an explicit-state demonic model checker confirming each spec as stated on the smallest instance per family); adversarial battery `mutants_sl.py` (9 positive controls + 8 fixture-layer + 6 chain-layer mutants, two of them cross-layer, each refused at the attacked layer).
